STAGE: objective read + design-space scan
GOAL: pick one in-scope mechanism for the curvature-as-design-target round, distinct from earlier rejected arms.
READ: task text only (round objective + evidence summary for results/research/sid_generation_forensics/ and analysis_sid_recall/curvature/report.md, quoted numbers: std level-3 curvature vs recall +0.26/+0.34, level-1 -0.16, L1-L3 -0.20 p=0.0095; used level-3 codes +0.42, collision rate -0.39; plain SID-quality R^2=0.60, curvature adds 1.5pp L1, 0.8pp L3; Issue #127 arm collapsed level-1 to 4 codes and recall 0.0513). No files opened from this sandbox yet.
OBSERVED: prior rounds already spent the obvious coupling slots: successor-weighted Poincare Frechet codebook (round 128), per-level curvature control from a feedback transition score (round 030015 CURVCTRL-SID), behaviour-ranked radial Poincare assignment from context entropy (round 093253 BRad-RQ), Lorentz successor-profile smoothing, prefix cones, branch-curvature MoE.
REASONING: to be different I should NOT re-use curvature as a loss weight, as a temperature, or as a successor-Frechet shift. The unused slot is curvature as an EMBEDDING COORDINATE: Ollivier-Ricci node potential of the training behaviour quotient graph mapped to the Poincare radial (hierarchy-depth) coordinate, with the per-level standardized curvature defect setting the per-level space curvature by a conservation law.
OPEN: verify the cost claims for a 2048-node quotient graph refresh and write the full spec block.

FINAL ANSWER SUMMARY: idea ORC-RADIAL-RQ. Mechanism: curvature as an EMBEDDING COORDINATE, not a loss weight/temperature/successor shift. Train-split consecutive-item co-occurrence graph A, contracted into each level's current prefix groups -> quotient graph Q_l (nodes cover 90% of transition mass, cap 2048) -> edge Ollivier curvature kappa(p,q)=1-W1(m_p,m_q)/d(p,q) with lazy walk P=(I+D^-1W)/2 and Sinkhorn (eps 0.05, 30 it, shortest-path ground metric) -> (a) per-node potential phi_p = transition-mass-weighted mean curvature, standardised and clipped at 3sd; (b) per-level defect D_l vs B=20 size-preserving label-shuffle null. Coupling: code k of level l is placed at Poincare radius rho_k = R_l*tanh(phi_hat_k) via e_k=exp_0^{c_l}(rho_k u_k) with R_l=1/sqrt(c_l) and per-level curvature by a conservation law c_l = c0*exp(-clip(D_l,-2,2)); assignment uses d_{H^{c_l}} to those radially placed codes, residual stays tangent-Euclidean. Refresh every 50 epochs (60 over 3000), linear interpolation. Behaviour-off: phi_hat=0, D_l=0 -> uniform shell at R_0, c_l=c0. Geometry-off: identity exp map, linear rho=phi_hat, L2 distance, c_l=0. Both-on is the single trained arm; no ablation arm is run; constants derived (90% mass, 3sd, 2sd, 1/sqrt(c), 50-epoch period from budget), none tuned. Cost: per step <0.1 ms (a gather of a 3x256 radius buffer, no extra fwd/bwd) at 24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 72000 steps; refreshes ~1-3 min CPU total (<1%). Observables: mean |D_l| falls, level-3 used codes rise (targets the +0.42 predictor), collision rate falls, prefix predictability rises, Stage3 test recall@10 > 0.065 and > 0.0513 of the Issue #127 collapse arm. Safeguards: norm clamps at 1e-8 and atanh(1-1e-6), radius floor 0.1R_l, degree>=2 filter, Sinkhorn fallback, unused codes get median radius, no manual widening to hide collapse. Distinct from earlier rejected arms (successor-Frechet codebook, per-level curvature from feedback transition score, behaviour-ranked radial assignment from context entropy, Lorentz profile smoothing, prefix cones, branch-curvature MoE).
